risk_note: RV2 settlement + orders port (B2-04l; BR-FUND-06/07/08/01). Settlement implements orders' rights.record (K-2 dedupe (app_id, order_id, type, platform_rights_no) NULLS NOT DISTINCT; PROCESSING → result and WAIT_COMMISSION → SUCCEEDED with deduction update the row in place; rights_pending only through transition(); rights success reaches the clawback entry, same terms as B2-04s) and rebate.adminHold / adminUnhold (R11, expected_row_version CAS; orders writes the audit). The CLAWBACK_NO_COMMISSION order_sync_pending row is opened / resolved only through orders' own clawback-pending port (single writer, D10-470). Per D10-470 the ports are not wired in production: pre-credit partial-rights N_new persistence and pre-credit WAIT_COMMISSION closing are B2-04lb; code TODOs point there and any task wiring these ports must depend on B2-04lb.
